checks.detail: Fail: the exact candidate boots cleanly and retains strong shell, draft, weapon, and reset work, but the Warden remains unreadable behind the mausoleum, all seven authored animation semantics remain unresolved, native dense qualification and an uninterrupted ordinary victory run are absent, and the cemetery UV issue reproduces.

Fail: physical W and Space produced planar traversal, anticipation, active dash, recovery, cooldown, invulnerability ownership, and clean pause/resume, but at Warden z=1.02 the guard reported two blocked samples and the mausoleum collider while the shipped frames showed only the lantern/halo rather than the complete Warden silhouette.

Fail for insufficient evidence: automatic projectiles, damage, enemy defeat, XP collection, distinct attack ledgers, and clean reset were observed, but this pass did not bind one complete ordinary cooldown-to-exactly-once-death/drop chain with matched audible onset, impact, and recovery receipts.

Fail for incomplete role-lifecycle coverage: the final-profile fixture resolved 32 enemies across four roles with validated lanes, a 12-candidate neighbor cap, telegraph/light caps, and zero registered neighbors after three resets, but full-capsule occupancy and each role's ordinary spawn-to-drop path were not all sampled. coverage.baseline.fps_enemy_occupancy_occlusion.586166354018=insufficient_evidence;

Fail for insufficient ordinary-path evidence: the paused three-choice draft was authored, truthful and full-viewport; one physical Right-plus-Space transaction selected Gravespade exactly once, matched its projection, equipped it, and resumed play, but reward-threshold overflow and naturally reached draft connectivity were not completed.

Fail for scale-coverage insufficiency: health, XP, level, wave, time, weapon, dash and boss values matched authoritative snapshots at 1280x720 and the authored Montserrat/icon hierarchy remained legible, but fullscreen and supported UI-scale states were not freshly exercised.

Pass: three prepare-advance-reset cycles plus a result Retry produced fresh run serials, ordinary route kind, zero enemies, boss, projectiles, pickups, effects, attack ledgers, Wisp handles/targets, neighbor registrations and audio voices on the next frame; pause and resume preserved authoritative ownership.

Pass: fresh Tester-owned project binding, source review, runtime digests, editor scene framing, spatial bounds, mesh validation, logical/physical input receipts, distributed gameplay frames, and final editor/runtime logs all bind candidate loop-13-8ae44aef6579; fixtures are identified as diagnostic and not treated as ordinary-route proof.

Pass: the representative build equipped rank-four focused Lantern bolts, a close Gravespade sweep, and four persistent Wisps with distinct strategies, cadence, damage, range, area and hit intervals; the natural-style draft also changed the build from Lantern-only to Lantern plus Gravespade exactly once.

Fail for insufficient ordinary-route evidence: source and snapshots expose five ordered data-driven wave IDs, escalating caps/compositions, elite intervals and a bounded Bellkeeper profile, but only prepared phase-one boss and diagnostic result states were reached; two phases, ordinary exactly-once defeat and terminal stop were not demonstrated.

Fail: the intact bounded cemetery, mausoleum, graves, fencing and escape lanes render coherently and broadly align with the frozen high-angle reference, but runtime validation still reports 69 error-severity degenerate-UV surfaces and the central landmark route does not retain a readable Warden silhouette.

Fail: idle, move, dash, cast, hurt and prepared victory changed semantic telemetry, yet binding_valid stayed false, all seven mappings and resolved clips remained empty, and the Warden therefore stayed static/unreadable; final logs were otherwise clean and dense VFX/light/audio work remained bounded.

Fail for coverage insufficiency: title, draft, pause, failure and victory result pages used authored icons, typography, full-viewport hierarchy, focus and truthful diagnostic summaries, but settings persistence, credits, mouse navigation and gamepad-equivalent traversal were not all freshly exercised.

Fail for qualification gap: three separated cycles resolved 32 four-role enemies, Bellkeeper, all weapons and explicit caps, then returned owned counts to isolated next-frame baselines; however the llvmpipe 1280x720 samples of p50 132-133 ms, p95 141-149 ms cannot establish native 1920x1080 performance. coverage.baseline.fps_runtime_stutter.6b972c8aebe3=insufficient_evidence;

Fail: ordinary title-to-control, failure/result Retry, diagnostic victory, three-weapon build and provenance surfaces were inspected, but no uninterrupted 420-600 second ordinary victory with five natural wave IDs and three natural build shapes was captured, and two major presentation regressions remain open.

required_criteria.requirement: Review candidate-bound runtime evidence against the PRD requirements for phase release_convergence.

Use ordinary keyboard and gamepad-equivalent input to verify camera-relative planar movement, collision sliding, visual facing, dash anticipation/invulnerability/recovery/cooldown, high-angle camera framing and clean pause/resume. Judge only behavior introduced by the active phase; reject hidden threats, contradictory velocity, stuck input or camera modes that drift toward FPS/TPS play.

Bind one stable event chain from cooldown and deterministic legal target selection through emitted attack, hit policy, damage, hurt, exactly-once death and drop. Require visible and audible anticipation, onset, impact and recovery without manual-fire drift, duplicate damage, freed targets, inert attacks or presentation disconnected from state.

Exercise active enemy roles from validated off-camera spawn through approach, separation, telegraph, attack, hurt, death, drop and pool return. Reject collision or out-of-bounds spawns, root sliding, static poses, first-frame damage, unreadable overlap, dead actors moving, permanent clumps, blocked escape lanes and stale pooled state.

Verify enemy reward, collection, experience threshold and overflow, one paused three-choice draft, debounced selection, authoritative build mutation and resumed play with an observable changed attack or utility. Reject duplicate drafts, held-confirm double choice, blank/inert cards, false values, lost overflow or gameplay clocks advancing under draft.

Require every introduced health, experience, level, wave/run, weapon, dash and boss field to match authoritative runtime state while leaving the arena readable. Judge native, fullscreen and supported UI scales; reject default fonts, debug labels, text piles, opaque blue/purple blocks, generic rounded cards, clipped controls and top-left-only pages.

From title through gameplay, pause, player failure and retry, verify single authoritative run transitions and a clean baseline after three restarts. Reject stale actors, timers, signals, pools, pause reasons, input ownership, attacks, effects or audio, and any state that requires restarting the application to recover.

Bind black-box ordinary play and white-box authoritative snapshots, events, transforms, animation/audio owners, logs and distributed frames to the exact candidate. Deterministic setup may reach legal branches, but normal runtime systems and input must cause the accepted outcome.

Exercise every weapon and representative upgrade path. Require focused bolts, close sweep and orbiting area control to retain distinct targeting, cadence, geometry, hit policy, feedback and build consequences rather than renamed copies of one projectile.

Verify five data-driven wave states, composition escalation, elite pressure and the Bellkeeper's two phases, telegraphs, summons or lane pressure, recovery window, exactly-once defeat and victory. The director must honor live caps and stop after terminal state.

Compare ordinary runtime views with the frozen Mournlight visual reference. Require one coherent bounded cemetery, grounded collision, keeper post, mausoleum and cracked bell landmarks, clear escape lanes, readable silhouettes, coherent scale/materials and no visible stand-ins.

Inspect accepted component/source values and every active animation state, moonlight/lantern hierarchy, causal bounded VFX and semantic audio layer under real crowd density. Reject unrelated fallback clips, sliding/dead movement, overdark or clipped light, leaked loops, hum, unexpected speech, generic tones and effects that hide telegraphs.

Navigate title, settings, upgrade, pause, death, victory and result pages across the full viewport with mouse, keyboard and gamepad focus. Verify persisted audio/window/UI-scale/effect settings, authored iconography and typography, truthful summaries and clean replay/title flow.

Profile the representative final wave and boss at 1920x1080 with 25-40 ordinary enemies, all weapon families, pickups, animation, VFX, lights, UI and audio. Require stable frame-time distribution, bounded high-churn work and no growth across three complete retries.

Play the complete seven-to-ten-minute title-to-result run, including failure and victory branches, three viable build shapes, statistics, credits/provenance and replay. Reject placeholders, debug presentation, missing required content or unresolved release-relevant regressions.
